subject: Remove the scroll zoom from the home page
body:
The "Every market. One core." section used to pin the screen for three
screen-heights and zoom into the nucleus as you scrolled, which made the
page feel stuck. It's now a normal section that scrolls with the page:
the headline and text fade in once and the price line draws once when it
comes into view. The home page is about 1,600px shorter.
